# Dr Marie Meechan, PhD — The Fertility Psychotherapist

> Specialist online fertility counselling and coaching with Dr Marie Meechan, PhD. Edinburgh-based, supporting clients worldwide through every season of the fertility journey — trying, treating, grieving, parenting after treatment, or rebuilding without children.

Dr Marie Meechan is a psychotherapist with a PhD in Counselling Studies (fertility impairment) from the University of Edinburgh and twelve years of lived experience of unexplained (in)fertility. She offers in-person sessions in Edinburgh, walk-and-talk sessions, and online sessions worldwide. Every engagement can begin with a free 15–20 minute introductory call.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.drmariemeechan.co.uk/): Specialist fertility psychotherapy for every season of the journey, and how to begin.
- [Meet Dr Marie](https://www.drmariemeechan.co.uk/about): Background, qualifications, doctoral research, and lived experience of infertility.
- [How sessions work](https://www.drmariemeechan.co.uk/sessions): Session formats, pricing (£90 per session, packages from £499), and the free introductory call.
- [Navigating & honouring your journey](https://www.drmariemeechan.co.uk/your-journey): Support for IVF, IUI, ICSI, recurrent loss, donor decisions, and grief that often goes unseen.
- [Becoming & belonging](https://www.drmariemeechan.co.uk/becoming-belonging): Support for the season after treatment — postnatal anxiety, IVF motherhood, and involuntary childlessness.
- [Training & speaking](https://www.drmariemeechan.co.uk/training): CPD training and speaking for counsellors, NHS teams, and reproductive health professionals.
- [Contact](https://www.drmariemeechan.co.uk/contact): Book a session or a free 15–20 minute introductory call. 24-hour response, complete confidentiality.

## Letters from Marie

Occasional reflective letters on fertility, loss, and hope.

- [Letters from Marie](https://www.drmariemeechan.co.uk/letters): The full collection; subscribe to receive new letters by email.
- [After the miracle baby](https://www.drmariemeechan.co.uk/letters/after-the-miracle-baby): Postnatal anxiety after fertility treatment, and why it makes complete sense.
- [What disenfranchised grief actually means](https://www.drmariemeechan.co.uk/letters/disenfranchised-grief): Grief that society doesn't recognise or validate, in the context of fertility loss.
- [The petri dish loss](https://www.drmariemeechan.co.uk/letters/petri-dish-loss): A failed IVF transfer is a real loss — the grief that begins in the clinic.
